title: High school in Texas
subtitle: Friday night football, ranch weekends, and six months in College Station.
teaser: Six months as an exchange student at A&M High School in College Station, Texas — from Friday night football to weekends out on the ranch.
description: In 10th grade, I spent six months as an exchange student in Texas, attending A&M Consolidated High School in College Station.

Everyday life was as quintessential American high school as it gets: packed stadium bleachers on Friday night football games, weekends out on local ranches, barbecue, and classic traditions like Prom.
Living with a host family, making friends from across the school, and stepping into a completely different daily rhythm far away from home made for an unforgettable semester.
Looking back, the time in Texas gave me great memories, noticeably improved my English, and built an early ease with settling into new environments and meeting new people.
